components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one irreversible action on a pane: Clip YouTube, Open a private studio, Make clip.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 16px; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; background: #c8f542; color: #08100a; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.18); transition: transform 140ms ease, filter 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.18), 0 0 0 3px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action: Queue, New post, email submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 16px; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; background: #151c28; color: #eef3f8; border: 1px solid #243042; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #3a4b63; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.12); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet action: Sign out, Open library, mode toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #243042; background: transparent; color: #8b97a8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #eef3f8; border-color: #3a4b63; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.12); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Ink well with uppercase steel label; lime bloom on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #8b97a8; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { background: #0a0f16; border: 1px solid #243042; color: #eef3f8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; outline: none; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.55); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.12); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #8b97a8; }

components.name: Rail Nav
components.description: Desktop 240px rail row. Active is lime text on lime veil.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: #8b97a8; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #eef3f8; background: rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.14); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #c8f542; background: rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.14); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 9px; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.14); color: #c8f542; border: 1px solid rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.22); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Default working surface for lists and splits.
components.html:
Recent posts

Your content tracker — platforms, status, performance.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(16, 21, 31, 0.88); border: 1px solid #243042; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px; color: #eef3f8; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-family: Syne, Avenir Next, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #8b97a8; font-size: 0.82rem; }

components.name: Login Card
components.description: Full-page auth gate before the rail exists.
components.html:
CO

ContentOS

Track posts and clip YouTube into Shorts packages.
components.css: .ds-login { width: min(440px, 100%); border: 1px solid #243042; background: rgba(12, 16, 24, 0.92); border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); color: #eef3f8; font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-login h1 { font-family: Syne, Avenir Next, sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; letter-spacing: -0.045em; margin: 14px 0 8px; } .ds-login h1 span { color: #c8f542; } .ds-login p { color: #8b97a8; margin: 0 0 22px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-mark { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #c8f542; color: #08100a; font-family: Syne, Avenir Next, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.35), 0 10px 30px rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.18); } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 16px; font-weight: 700; background: #c8f542; color: #08100a; }

components.name: Shorts Phone
components.description: Vertical viral preview with burned-in captions and lime punch word.
components.css: .ds-phone { max-width: 220px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 10px 10px 18px; border-radius: 28px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a1f2a 0%, #0a0d12 55%, #121820 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-notch { display: block; width: 64px; height: 8px; margin: 4px auto 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #05070b; } .ds-stage { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 9/16; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; } .ds-caption { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 28%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 88%; text-align: center; font-family: Syne, Avenir Next, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.4px #000; paint-order: stroke fill; } .ds-caption em { font-style: normal; color: #c8f542; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.4px #000; }

narrative.overview:
ContentOS is a night-shift editorial desk: almost-black ink, steel panel seams, and a single electric-lime marker. Surfaces are opaque instrument panels, not frosted glass. The lime is a cutting tool — brand mark, active nav, primary CTA, viral scores, Shorts highlight words — not a wash across the room.

Density is generous and operational. The authenticated shell is a 240px sticky rail plus a working canvas (28px / 36px padding). Login is a centered 440px card before any chrome exists. Motion is a short rise (translateY(8px) over ~480ms) and a 1px CTA lift on hover. The world rejects SaaS white, second accents (blue/purple/gold as brand), and filling large interiors with solid lime.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink ground with a faint lime bloom (top-right) and a cool atmospheric wash (bottom-left) that is not a token
Syne for display titles, Manrope for the working voice, IBM Plex Mono for timecodes and metrics
Lime as a marker: brand square, active states, primary CTA, score numerals
Vertical Shorts phone stage as the signature artifact, not a marketing hero
Desktop rail + mobile five-tab dock; no sidebar on small screens

rules.name: The Lime Rarity Rule
rules.body: #c8f542 is a marker. It belongs on the brand square, the one irreversible CTA on a pane, active nav, scores, and caption highlights. It does not fill large panel interiors.

rules.name: The Steel-Not-Gray Rule
rules.body: Text, borders, and muted copy stay in the cool steel family. Neutral gray and white cards are out of world.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Syne signs the room. Manrope does the work. Do not set body copy in Syne or headlines in a third face.

rules.name: The Opaque Desk Rule
rules.body: Panels are ink slabs with a seam. Do not restyle them into frosted glass or a flat #111 rectangle “for contrast.”

rules.name: The One-Pixel Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover on primary CTAs is translateY(-1px) and brightness(1.05). Anything larger leaves the cutting room.

dos: Do build new panes from .cos-panel / .cos-stat / .cos-login-card and the radius steps (10 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 28).
Do keep Syne on titles, scores, and Shorts captions; Manrope on body, forms, and nav; mono on timecodes.
Do treat #c8f542 as a marker: brand square, one primary CTA, active nav, scores, caption highlights.
Do collapse the rail into the five-tab dock under 980px and keep 18px page gutters.
Do keep hover to a 1px lift, a brighter seam, or lime veil — not a color swap into another world.
Do keep Shorts captions uppercase Syne with a black stroke and lime on the punch word.
donts: Don't introduce opaque white or slate cards, Inter/system display faces, or a second accent (blue, purple, gold) as brand.
Don't fill large surfaces with solid #c8f542.
Don't restyle panels into glassmorphism or a marketing hero/kicker stack. This is an operate surface.
Don't use hard offset drop shadows or default blue focus rings.
Don't promote page-title eyebrows into a required system element — the live .cos-kicker is a defect to retire, not a pattern to copy.
Don't expand Lucide glyph-icon language as identity; the brand square and lime marker already sign the room.
